one_sentence_role: Shows that the full character space of a closed unitization subalgebra is countable when π is a separably acting representative of the unique irreducible-representation class.

For each character other than infinityCharacterOn D, the prior source theorem supplies a joint unit eigenvector. Distinct characters give orthogonal vectors, so separability of H makes that complement countable. The source then maps the disjoint sum of the complement and one Unit onto the entire character space.
